svg.desc: From CA Commercial Driver Handbook DL 650 (REV 12/2019) section 9.3.11 and Figures 9.7-9.8 (pp. 9-10-9-11), consistent with 49 CFR 172.504. Always use the current HMR and the shipping paper -- not this study chart alone -- to placard a real load.

svg.text: Placard whenever any amount is transported

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
text.tspan: 1.1, 1.2, 1.3 -- Explosives
2.3 -- Poison / toxic gas
4.3 -- Dangerous when wet
5.2 -- Organic peroxide Type B, liquid or solid, temperature-controlled
6.1 -- Inhalation hazard Zone A or B
7 -- Radioactive Yellow-III label only

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Except bulk packaging (and other stated exceptions)

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
text.tspan: 1.4, 1.5, 1.6 explosives
2.1 Flammable gas 2.2 Non-flammable gas
3 Flammable (Combustible*)
4.1 Flammable solid 4.2 Spontaneously combustible
5.1 Oxidizer 5.2 (other than Table 1 Type B)
6.1 (other than inhalation Zone A/B)
8 Corrosive 9 Miscellaneous**

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
text.tspan: • A placarded vehicle needs at least 4 identical placards: front, rear, and both sides. They are diamond-shaped, at
least 9.84 in (250 mm) square, readable from all four directions.
• DANGEROUS may replace separate Table 2 placards when you have 1,001 lb or more of two or more Table 2 classes that
need different placards, AND you have not loaded 2,205 lb or more of any one Table 2 class at any one place (that
class must have its own placard). Optional -- you may always placard for the materials.
• INHALATION HAZARD on the paper or package: display POISON GAS or POISON INHALATION in addition to any other required
placard. The 1,000-pound exception does not apply. Same idea for a dangerous-when-wet subsidiary hazard.
• Bulk packaging (over 119 gallons) must be placarded even if it only has residue. *FLAMMABLE may replace COMBUSTIBLE
on a cargo tank or portable tank. **Class 9 placard is not required for domestic transportation.
